fields.name: after
fields.description: Identifier for the last eval from the previous pagination request.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order for evals by timestamp. Use `asc` for ascending order or `desc` for descending order.

fields.name: order_by
fields.description:
Evals can be ordered by creation time or last updated time. Use
`created_at` for creation time or `updated_at` for last updated time.

fields.name: data_source_config
fields.description: Configuration of data sources used in runs of the evaluation.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the eval was created.
